audit_items.proof_trace: The property is enforced by two symmetric guards: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) asserts `!debts.contains(CoinType)` before adding to ctokens, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) asserts `!ctokens.is_supporting_collateral(CoinType)` before adding to debts. `join_ctoken` is only called from `deposit_ctoken` (no bypass), and `wit_table::add` on debts is only called from `try_borrow_asset`; the private `debts` field has no external `&mut` accessor. Both sides clean up on zero balance (`split_ctoken` removes ctoken entry at L91-96; `unsafe_repay_debt_only` removes debt entry at L190), so the invariant holds across the full lifecycle.
